answer: Each identity must serve rotating harbor duty: every epoch the beacon assigns each agent one real grading or audit task, and the pulse of new assignments cannot be predicted or delegated. A fake identity costs a full hour of careful, gold-standard-checked work per epoch; skipping duty or rubber-stamping halves its weight and burns its 20 POA bond, while honest service slowly raises it. Ten fakes mean ten hours of audited labor every epoch, so scale itself becomes the price.
